collection.title: KIA Stinger 2017 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A KIA Stinger 2017 - 2023 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
